Definition: Shemer, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shemer or Shamer or Shamed = "preserved"; 1) the owner of the hill where the city of Samaria was built; 2) a Merarite Levite, son of Mahli and father of Bani; 3) an Asherite, son of Heber and father of Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram. Also 'Shomer'; 4) a Benjamite, son of Elpaal and builder of the towns of Ono and Lod
